signals.entity: NBRSM (National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia)
signals.signal: PRIMARY, machine-readable absolute device counts obtained for the first time (Cloudflare defeated via a real browser session): NBRSM Table 3 'Places of sale and card-accepting terminal devices' (monthly, last revised 25/06/2026) gives ATMs 1,136 at Mar-2026 (Q1-2026) vs 1,062 Mar-2025 (+7.0% y/y) and 1,132 Dec-2025; cash-DEPOSIT-capable ATMs 473 at Mar-2026 vs 406 Mar-2025 (+16.5% y/y) and 449 Dec-2025 - deposit share now 41.6% of the fleet; credit-transfer-capable ATMs 545; contactless ATMs 673. POS terminals 36,260 (EFTPOS 36,185, contactless 35,275 = 97.5%); self-service payment terminals 232 (199 contactless); e-commerce merchant places 2,299.
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Payment statistics, Table 3 - Places of sale and card-accepting terminal devices (Q1-2026 file, last revised 25/06/2026)
signals.implies: North Macedonia is the clearest ATM-GROWTH market in the SEE footprint - fleet up while EU peers shrink - and the growth is concentrated in intelligent-deposit machines (a deposit ATM accepts notes from customers; a recycler re-dispenses those same notes). 473 deposit-capable of 1,136 leaves ~660 dispense-only ATMs as a recycler/TCR upgrade pipeline, plus NCR Atleos hardware, x-core multivendor software and device telemetry/managed services on a fleet adding ~70-90 units a year.
signals.likelihood: High - fleet has grown every quarter for 27 consecutive months
signals.followup: Pull NBRSM Table 3 Q2-2026 file (URL pattern 'Tabela 3 Q2 2026.xlsx') once posted - 90-day lag means due ~end-Sep 2026.

signals.signal: NBRSM Table 2 'Card functions' (monthly, dated 25/06/2026): total cards 2,020,552 at Mar-2026 (Q1-2026) vs 1,967,969 Mar-2025 (+2.7%); cards with a MOBILE-PAYMENT (tokenized) solution 353,863 at Mar-2026 vs 148,970 Mar-2025 = +137.5% y/y, and 290,202 at Dec-2025 - i.e. tokenized cards grew a further 22% in a single quarter and now represent 17.5% of all cards. Contactless cards 1,977,099 (97.8%); debit 1,739,112; credit 264,232 (still shrinking, -0.3% y/y).
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Payment statistics, Table 2 - Card functions (Q1-2026 file, dated 25/06/2026)
signals.implies: Tokenization more than doubling y/y off a 2.0m-card base drives card-issuing/management, HSM and remote key-injection (Thales) and digital-wallet provisioning work; the flat-to-shrinking credit-card count says the growth is wallet-led, not new plastic. Also raises card-not-present fraud exposure - transaction-monitoring (INETCO) and fraud/AML angles.
signals.likelihood: High - four consecutive quarters of >20% q/q tokenization growth
signals.followup: Cross-check Table 4.2 (fraudulently initiated transactions) for the CNP fraud trend that would justify a transaction-monitoring pitch.

signals.signal: FIRST primary branch series for this market: NBRSM Table 3.2 'Branches, ATMs, agents and terminal devices at physical points of sale - geographic breakdown by municipality' (annual, last revised 27/03/2026) national total row gives BANK BRANCHES 409 (2020) -> 401 (2021) -> 397 (2022) -> 393 (2023) -> 384 (2024) -> 371 (end-2025): -3.4% in 2025 and -9.3% over five years. The same table's ATM totals reconcile exactly with Table 3 (1,041 end-2024, 1,132 end-2025), and EFTPOS 34,778 (2024) -> 36,010 (2025), of which 1,956 sit in public services/state institutions.
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Payment statistics, Table 3.2 - Branches, ATMs, agents and POS terminal devices by municipality (2025 file, last revised 27/03/2026)
signals.implies: A textbook branch-transformation setup: 38 branches closed since 2020 (-9.3%) while the ATM fleet grew 14% and deposit-capable ATMs rose from ~385 to 449. Every closed branch has to be replaced by self-service capacity - bank kiosks, intelligent-deposit/recycling ATMs (a cash recycler is an ATM that re-dispenses notes customers deposited, cutting cash-in-transit trips) and assisted-service terminals. Also 1,956 POS terminals inside public bodies = a public-sector kiosk/e-government payment angle.
signals.likelihood: High - branch count has fallen every single year since 2020
signals.followup: Get the per-municipality 2025 branch/ATM detail to identify the districts where branches closed but no deposit ATM replaced them - that is the kiosk/recycler target list. Next update due 27/03/2027 per the NBRSM calendar.

signals.signal: NBRSM Table 5 'Payment transactions by type of terminal device' (monthly, last revised 25/06/2026) shows ATM cash DEPOSITS growing far faster than withdrawals. Mar-2026: ATM cash deposits 230,698 transactions worth MKD 3,651,257,474 (~EUR 59.4m) vs Mar-2025 176,168 / MKD 2,386,328,345 = +31.0% by count and +53.0% by value y/y. ATM cash WITHDRAWALS Mar-2026: 2,498,982 transactions worth MKD 19,269,407,488 (~EUR 313m) vs Mar-2025 2,416,117 / MKD 17,234,062,317 = only +3.4% count / +11.8% value. Deposits are now equivalent to 19.0% of withdrawal VALUE, up from 13.8% a year earlier. Total card transactions Mar-2026 18,408,720 worth MKD 38,822,103,399.
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Payment statistics, Table 5 - Payment transactions by type of terminal device (Q1-2026 file, last revised 25/06/2026)
signals.implies: This is the single strongest RECYCLER business case in the region: cash-in value now equals ~19% of cash-out value at the ATM, so a recycling ATM in North Macedonia can already re-dispense roughly a fifth of the notes it pays out, cutting CIT replenishment runs and vault float. Direct fit for NCR intelligent-deposit/recycling ATMs, Glory/Sesami TCRs in branches, and NCR APTRA OptiCash cash-forecasting/optimisation (the Erste Croatia OptiCash reference travels well here).
signals.likelihood: High - deposit value has grown >30% y/y for four consecutive quarters
signals.followup: Ask which of the ~473 deposit ATMs are true recyclers vs deposit-only; pitch OptiCash against the MKD 19.3bn/month withdrawal load.

signals.signal: PRIMARY confirmation that domestic INSTANT payments are still NOT live: NBRSM Table 7 'Payments processed through the payment systems' (monthly, last revised 25/06/2026) carries an explicit 'Instant' sub-column for both MIPS (RTGS) and KIBS (clearing), and it reads ZERO for every month from Jan-2024 through Mar-2026. MIPS handled 656,970 credit transfers worth MKD 1,008,392,651,816 (~EUR 16.4bn) in Mar-2026 alone; all of it non-instant. The reporting schema already exists, which means NBRSM has pre-built the statistical plumbing for an instant scheme it expects to switch on.
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Payment statistics, Table 7 - Payments processed through the payment systems (Q1-2026 file, last revised 25/06/2026)
signals.implies: North Macedonia is the largest SEE market in the footprint with NO instant-payment rail yet, while BiH and Montenegro went live on the Banca d'Italia 'TIPS Clone' on 20/07/2026. When MK onboards, every bank needs ISO 20022 message adaptation, 24/7/365 channel and liquidity handling, instant-payment fraud screening and QR acceptance at POS - the whole instant-payments/ISO 20022 lane plus INETCO transaction monitoring.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High - schema is built and a second TIPS-Clone onboarding window is expected Nov-2026
signals.followup: Confirm with NBRSM/Banca d'Italia whether North Macedonia is in the Nov-2026 TIPS-Clone onboarding window and whether MIPS instant go-live has an official date.

signals.signal: Hard forward calendar obtained (file 'Kalendar na objavuvanje na podatoci za platezhna statistika 2026.xlsx', last changed 17/12/2025): all quarterly payment-statistics tables (institutions, card functions, card-accepting devices, transactions by instrument, transactions by terminal type, payment-system participation, payments processed) publish at T+90 days on 23 SEPTEMBER 2026 for Q2-2026, 22 DECEMBER 2026 for Q3-2026 and 22 MARCH 2027 for Q4-2026. The annual tables - including Table 3.2 with BRANCH counts - publish 22/03/2027 for full-year 2026.
signals.source_name: NBRSM, Calendar for publishing payment-statistics data 2026
signals.implies: Removes the guesswork from the collector's refresh cycle: the Q2-2026 device/ATM/POS/tokenization figures land 23/09/2026, four weeks out. Lets Printec time its ATM/POS fleet-growth pitch to the data release rather than to press y/y percentages.
signals.followup: Re-pull Tables 2, 3, 5 and 7 with the 'Q2 2026' filename on/after 23/09/2026.

signals.entity: NBRSM Vice-Governor Igor Velichkovski / World Bank - merchant acceptance gap
signals.signal: At the NBRSM-World Bank workshop 'Bridging the merchant electronic-payment acceptance gap' (Skopje, 18/06/2026), Vice-Governor Igor Velichkovski gave the hardest acceptance numbers yet published: 84% of citizens hold a payment account, 3 in 4 account holders have sent or received a digital payment, internet/mobile coverage exceeds 90% - BUT more than 90% of purchases at SMALL merchants are still paid in cash, and the country's ~36,000 acceptance devices sit at only ~16,700 merchants, i.e. acceptance is heavily concentrated. He named the fixes: instant payments via the TIPS Clone 'by the end of this year' (end-2026), a NATIONAL INTEROPERABLE QR code usable across all PSPs regardless of provider, alias-based payments, instant transaction confirmation, Request-to-Pay, and further mobile apps including from non-bank providers. 'Small merchants still see electronic payments as expensive and complicated.'
signals.source_name: NBRSM press release, 'Vice-Governor Velichkovski: simple and cheap digital solutions for greater acceptance of electronic payments among small merchants'
signals.implies: The central bank has publicly declared the long tail of small merchants its priority and named low-cost acceptance as the answer - this is the explicit policy opening for softPOS/tap-to-phone (turning a merchant's own Android phone into a card terminal, no hardware to buy), plus Verifone/Castles entry-level POS and a TMS to manage a fleet that must roughly double if the ~16,700 accepting merchants is to widen. The national QR scheme and alias/Request-to-Pay layer add acquiring-side integration work.
signals.likelihood: High - central-bank-sponsored programme with World Bank support and a named end-2026 milestone
signals.followup: Track the workshop's published conclusions/next steps and whether NBRSM issues a national QR standard; approach acquirers (Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB, Halkbank) with a softPOS + TMS bundle aimed at the sub-scale merchant tail.

signals.entity: NBRSM / Banca d'Italia TIPS Clone - North Macedonia onboarding
signals.signal: North Macedonia's accession to the regional TIPS-Clone instant-payment platform is now CONFIRMED for NOVEMBER 2026, publicly flagged by ECB President Christine Lagarde at a monetary-policy press conference and announced by NBRSM on 24/07/2026; the same window covers Albania and Kosovo, joining Bosnia & Herzegovina and Montenegro who went live 20/07/2026. Separately, NBRSM announced on 04/08/2026 that during JULY 2026 it completed, together with the banks and other MIPS participants, the FIRST TESTING CYCLE of the new MIPS system solution, confirming its functionality, with most project payment messages processed to the ISO 20022 standard. The MIPS overhaul sits inside the EU-financed project 'Strengthening the capacity of the National Bank in external statistics, payment statistics and payment systems' (which also builds an external-statistics data warehouse). Bilyana Donovska-Gecheva, Director of the Payment Systems Department, said work continues to finalise testing and prepare the new solution for regular use.
signals.source_name: NBRSM press releases: 'ECB highlighted the country's accession to the instant-payments initiative' (24/07/2026) and 'Modernisation of the Macedonian Interbank Payment System advances with EU support' (04/08/2026)
signals.implies: A dated, funded, ECB-blessed programme roughly 10 weeks out. Every MIPS participant bank must be ISO 20022-ready and 24/7/365-capable by November: ISO 20022 message mapping and channel work, instant-payment liquidity handling, real-time fraud screening (INETCO transaction monitoring), HSM/key management for a new rail, and QR acceptance at the POS estate. This is the single largest discrete opportunity in North Macedonia and it recurs across the whole TIPS-Clone bloc where Printec already sells.
signals.likelihood: High - ECB-confirmed November 2026 window, first test cycle already passed
signals.followup: Confirm the exact November-2026 go-live date and which MK banks are in wave 1; map the ISO 20022 / 24-7 readiness gap per bank.

signals.entity: NBRSM - Q1-2026 digital channel statistics (now primary-sourced)
signals.signal: NBRSM release of 01/07/2026 (reference period Q1-2026), previously only available to this collector via press: citizens' payment-order transactions +10.3% by count / +14.6% by value y/y; ELECTRONIC payments +21.9% count / +23.0% value; MOBILE APPS accounted for 72.8% of all electronically initiated transactions, themselves +25.9% y/y; card payments +12.2% count / +14.5% value, driven by internet card payments (+18.7%) and physical POS payments (+11.7%). DIGITIZED (tokenized) cards are 17.9% of all cards issued in the country, and each digitized card averaged 4 domestic mobile transactions in the quarter.
signals.source_name: NBRSM press release, 'Use of digital payment channels by citizens grows further in Q1-2026'
signals.implies: Mobile is now the dominant initiation channel (72.8%) yet physical POS payments still grew 11.7% - the estate is not being cannibalised, it is being extended, which supports both a POS/TMS refresh cycle and digital-channel/wallet work. 4 transactions per digitized card per quarter is still low usage, i.e. headroom that the national QR + instant rail is designed to unlock.
signals.followup: Re-read the equivalent Q2-2026 release, expected alongside the 23/09/2026 statistics publication.

signals.entity: Stopanska banka AD Skopje - 'm-banking' mobile app [LEADING INDICATOR]
signals.signal: LEADING INDICATOR - a digital-channel failure in progress at one of the country's largest banks. Stopanska banka's Android app 'm-banking by Stopanska banka' (package mk.com.stb) carries a 1.0 out of 5.0 rating across 2,340 ratings on Google Play, with its most recent release dated 31/07/2026 - a rating floor that in practice only occurs after a forced migration to a rebuilt app. For contrast on the same date and the same store: NLB mKlik Makedonija 3.3/5 (2,560 ratings, updated 03/07/2026), Halkbank retail app 3.5/5 (954 ratings, updated 09/07/2026), Ohridska banka 4.1/5 (559 ratings, updated 20/07/2026). Ratings read 31/08/2026.
signals.implies: Momentum proxy, not a structural count. NBRSM data says mobile apps now carry 72.8% of all electronically initiated payments, so a broken app is a broken bank: it pushes customers back to branch and ATM exactly as the branch network shrinks. Opens a digital-channels / self-service remediation conversation (assisted-service kiosks and deposit ATMs to absorb the displaced traffic now, digital-channel and device-telemetry work to stop it recurring), and it is a competitive wedge at a bank that has just proven its incumbent channel supplier failed.
signals.likelihood: High - rating is current and the release is 4 weeks old
signals.followup: Read the recent Macedonian-language reviews to identify what broke (SCA/token migration is the likely trigger, see the 01/03/2026 strong-authentication mandate), and approach Stopanska banka on digital channels + self-service overflow capacity.

signals.entity: NBRSM - mandatory strong customer authentication for online card payments
signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 2026] From 01/03/2026 the legal obligation under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems requires every bank in North Macedonia to apply STRONG CUSTOMER AUTHENTICATION (an extra proof of identity beyond the card details) to online card payments. SMS one-time codes are replaced by in-app approval in the bank's own mobile application, confirmed with an app PIN, fingerprint or face recognition. NBRSM states this closes the final phase of a staged roll-out that had already covered online account access, in-person card payments and e-/m-banking transfers, and completes alignment with the EU PSD2 security standard. Announced by NBRSM on 27/02/2026.
signals.source_name: NBRSM announcement, reported by Skopje1.mk and Meta.mk ('Од 1 март стапува во сила законската обврска за засилена автентикација при онлајн плаќање')
signals.implies: Every MK issuer now has to run app-based authentication, biometrics and cryptographic key handling for a 2.02m-card base of which 353,863 are already tokenized. That is direct demand for Thales HSM / PCI-PIN and remote key injection, card-issuing and token-provisioning work, and - because SCA moves fraud from card-present to social-engineering and account takeover - for behavioural transaction monitoring (INETCO) and FICO/IMTF Siron fraud rules. It also explains why one large bank's app rebuild has gone badly (see the Stopanska banka signal): the migration is compulsory and technically hard.
signals.followup: Obtain the NBRSM decision text on the nbrm.mk regulations page and check whether a formal exemption/RTS-style regime (low-value, TRA) is defined - that is where transaction-risk-analysis engines get sold.

signals.entity: Republic of North Macedonia - Law on electronic documents, electronic identification and trust services (EUDI Wallet alignment)
signals.signal: [STANDING - adopted 27/06/2025, money lands 2026-2027] Parliament adopted, at its 58th session on 27/06/2025, amendments to the Law on Electronic Documents, Electronic Identification and Trust Services that align the country with EU Regulation 2024/1183 - the regulation that creates the European Digital Identity (EUDI) Wallet. The proposal's own fiscal statement budgets MKD 9,000,000 for 2025, MKD 200,000,000 for 2026 and MKD 200,000,000 for 2027 (~EUR 3.25m per year at 61.49 MKD/EUR) for implementation. It was one of four digital-transformation reform-agenda laws passed that day. In parallel the government is rolling out a national ID wallet holding digital ID cards and driving licences, and the national eID is already integrated with banks (NLB) for remote identification and qualified e-signature; Halkbank launched fully online account opening and e-/m-banking activation with no branch visit and no paper, running an acquisition campaign from 01/02/2026.
signals.source_name: Proposal for a Law amending the Law on Electronic Documents, Electronic Identification and Trust Services (fiscal implications section), Economic Chamber of North Macedonia; MKD.mk report on the 58th parliamentary session; Halkbank online onboarding page
signals.implies: A funded, legislated EUDI-wallet track with ~EUR 3.25m of state money in each of 2026 and 2027, in a market where banks are already the anchor relying parties for the national eID. Direct fit for Namirial digital onboarding / eKYC and qualified e-signature, for wallet-acceptance integration in bank channels, and downstream for AML/KYC (IMTF Siron) because remote onboarding raises the CDD bar. First-mover banks (Halkbank, NLB) prove the demand is live rather than theoretical.
signals.likelihood: High - law adopted, budget lines set for 2026 and 2027
signals.followup: Get the bylaws/implementing acts under the amended law and the Ministry of Digital Transformation procurement plan for the 2026 MKD 200m line; ask which MK banks are certified relying parties for the national eID.

signals.entity: Komercijalna banka AD Skopje - branch transformation (Makpetrol branch)
signals.signal: BANK-LEVEL branch-transformation evidence: Komercijalna banka AD Skopje completely modernised its Makpetrol branch (reported 27/04/2026), fitting it with a DIGITAL KIOSK for commission-free utility and telecom bill payment (EVN, Telekom, A1, BEG, Telekabel) usable with ANY bank's card and with no teller involvement, plus a modern ATM that takes cash DEPOSITS as well as withdrawals, and step-free access for people with reduced mobility. Under a promotion running to 31/12/2026, businesses can pay in daily takings at that ATM free of charge with a Visa Business Debit or Mastercard Business Debit card. Branch staffed Mon-Fri 08:00-16:00 only, with the self-service devices carrying the rest.
signals.source_name: Bankarstvo.mk, 'Експозитурата Макпетрол на Комерцијална банка целосно модернизирана за уште подобро корисничко искуство'
signals.implies: This is the national branch-count decline (409 in 2020 to 371 at end-2025) turning into concrete per-site spend: kiosk + intelligent-deposit ATM + accessible layout is exactly the Printec branch-transformation bundle (bank kiosks, NCR intelligent-deposit/recycling ATMs, Glory/Sesami TCRs behind the counter, accessibility-compliant fit-out, managed field services). Free BUSINESS cash deposit at the ATM to 31/12/2026 is a deliberate push of SME cash off the teller and onto the machine - the classic precursor to buying recyclers, because deposited notes are what a recycler re-dispenses. Every remaining branch of the largest MK bank is a repeat of this template.
signals.likelihood: High - programme already executing branch by branch
signals.followup: Ask Komercijalna banka how many of its branches are scheduled for the same treatment in 2026-2027 and who supplied the kiosk and the deposit ATM; the free-business-deposit promo expiring 31/12/2026 is the natural moment to pitch OptiCash and recyclers on the resulting volumes.

coverage_notes: Resumed from checkpoint (9 signals collected 27/08/2026 kept unchanged, all primary NBRSM Excel tables obtained via a real browser session). This completion pass on 31/08/2026 closed five of the six listed gaps and added 4 signals: (1) eKYC/digital identity - found the adopted EUDI-Wallet alignment law with MKD 200m budget lines for 2026 and 2027 plus live bank eKYC (Halkbank fully-online onboarding from 01/02/2026, NLB eID/e-signature integration); (2) compliance - found the mandatory strong-customer-authentication regime in force 01/03/2026 under the Law on Payment Services (this is the local PSD2-equivalent; there is NO DORA-equivalent operational-resilience act in North Macedonia - the applicable instrument remains the NBRSM 'Decision on the Methodology for the security of the bank's information system', and no 2026 amendment to it was found); (3) accessibility - no European Accessibility Act transposition or banking accessibility mandate found (North Macedonia is not an EU member); the only accessibility evidence found is bank-level (step-free branch fit-out at Komercijalna banka); (4) AML - the only new item is the National Strategy for Fighting Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing 2026-2029 and the 4-yearly National Risk Assessment duty; no 2026 AML law amendment or enforcement action surfaced this run; (5) leading indicators - swept Google Play ratings for the four main MK bank apps on 31/08/2026 and found a live digital-channel failure at Stopanska banka (1.0/5, 2,340 ratings, release 31/07/2026); (6) bank-level device news - found Komercijalna banka's Makpetrol branch transformation (kiosk + deposit ATM + accessible layout, free business cash deposit to 31/12/2026). GAP NOT CLOSED: the absolute CASH-IN-CIRCULATION series. NBRSM publishes monetary aggregates only through the NBStat PxWeb portal (nbstat.nbrm.mk/pxweb/mk/ - reachable, but an old ASP.NET postback UI with no REST API) and through a monthly press-release PDF. I did extract the Jul-2026 monetary press-release PDF's numeric grid, but its Cyrillic row labels use a custom font encoding that does not map to Unicode, so the rows cannot be attributed to a metric - and per the hard rules I will not guess which row is currency in circulation. No currency-in-circulation figure is therefore reported. Cash TREND is instead reported from primary ATM flow data (Table 5): ATM withdrawal value +11.8% y/y while ATM deposit value +53.0% y/y at Mar-2026. Categories with NOTHING found this run: physical ATM security / anti-skimming (none found); card-issuing tenders (none found); HSM/remote-key-injection procurement (none found - inferred demand only, from the SCA mandate); core-banking replacement (none found); public ATM/POS tender notices (none found - no MK e-procurement notice surfaced).
access_issues: nbrm.mk returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' JS challenge) to BOTH WebFetch and desktop-UA curl, on HTML pages AND on direct /content/*.xlsx and /content/*.pdf paths - the documented desktop-UA workaround does NOT work here. Also blocked: r.jina.ai proxy (returns the Cloudflare interstitial). WORKING ROUTE: open nbrm.mk in a real browser (Claude browser pane / preview_start), let the JS challenge auto-solve, then use in-page fetch() on the /content/... path - same-origin requests carry the cf_clearance cookie and return HTTP 200. The cookie is httpOnly so it cannot be exported to curl, and blob-download did not land a file on the local filesystem, so binary files must be handled inside the page. For PDFs I inflated the FlateDecode streams in-page with DecompressionStream('deflate') and pulled the text operators - this works for numbers but NOT for Cyrillic labels (custom font encoding, no usable ToUnicode). NEW ROUTE DISCOVERED: nbstat.nbrm.mk/pxweb/mk/ returns 200 to plain desktop-UA curl (Cloudflare does not cover this host), exposing the NBStat statistical portal with the 'MS i KS' (monetary + interest-rate statistics), 'Eksterni statistiki' and 'Finansiski smetki' databases. However nbstat.nbrm.mk/ root is 403 and there is no PxWeb REST API (/pxweb/api/v1/... errors); navigation requires ASP.NET __VIEWSTATE postbacks. Payment statistics are NOT in NBStat. Blocked and abandoned: https://www.nbrm.mk/ns-newsarticle-soopstenie-monetarni-dvizenja-juli-2026.nspx (403, guessed slug).
operator_requests: 1) NBStat PxWeb (https://nbstat.nbrm.mk/pxweb/mk/MS%20i%20KS/) - an operator with a browser should drill 'Monetarna statistika' -> monetary aggregates and export the CURRENCY IN CIRCULATION (Пари во оптек) monthly series 2019-2026 to CSV; it is the one metric this run could not obtain and the portal needs interactive postbacks. 2) The same operator should download the NBRSM annual payment-statistics narrative 'Информација за платежната статистика' for 2025 from nbrm.mk (Cloudflare-gated) - the Excel tables are already captured, but the narrative carries the banks' own commentary on ATM/recycler and branch plans. 3) Confirm with NBRSM Payment Systems Department (contact.statistika@nbrm.mk / Bilyana Donovska-Gecheva) the exact November-2026 TIPS-Clone go-live date and wave-1 bank list.
